answer: Because the zephyr graph is rebuilt each epoch, the whisper merge is applied at settlement and the delta audit lists every linked key. Identities funded from a common source within 44 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. A farm paying its aliases from one wallet hence collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. That is 5 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
